component.name: TopMonitoring
component.summary: Fast and customizable Linux system-monitor topbar

description.p: TopMonitoring displays CPU, memory, temperature, GPU, disk, network, battery, media, and hardware sensor data in a native GTK4 bar.
Version 2 adds asynchronous integrations, three layout zones, per-module styling, safe custom commands, and a redesigned settings UI.
Version 3 alpha adds isolated providers, immutable snapshots, diff-based rendering, health diagnostics, and adaptive priority overflow.

Stable v3 release: frame-clock effect engine, Theme Studio color/typography/border controls with live preview, Layout Editor with per-zone modules and keyboard action, searchable filterable module catalog, fixed recurring Settings Gtk-CRITICAL warnings, and removed legacy CSS-recompile path.
Adds global Settings search, a filterable lazy module catalog, responsive navigation, keyboard flow, and an always-clickable More popover.
Adds deterministic normal, compact, tiny, and overflow layout tiers, a live More popover, priority survival, and width-aware disk output.
Moves native metric collection, process rows, and sensor scans off GTK; adds immutable core snapshots, freshness diagnostics, and diff-based widget reconciliation.
Separates fast and slow providers, adds freshness and error diagnostics, and centralizes metadata for all built-in modules.
Starts the approved v3 reliability phase with a priority action lane, desktop-aware Lock fallbacks, responsive disk text, module search, and signed X11 geometry validation.
Fixes legacy no-Wayland Debian package migration and release gates.
Major architecture, security, customization, and visual upgrade.
